description: Join multiple video or audio files in order into a single file. Uses stream copy for matching files or re-encodes when formats differ.

inputPaths.description: List of media files to concatenate in sequential order

mode.description: Concatenation mode. 'lossless' uses stream copy without quality loss (inputs must share codecs). 'reencode' normalizes differing resolutions/codecs.

name: concat_media
